interpretation.variance: sample covariance trace (B-1); all logit coordinates; no division by dimension
interpretation.mse: average squared error of one N-episode batch estimate, not error of the grand mean
interpretation.bias: signed mean-minus-exact intervals for every coordinate; plot the predetermined H/1 EAST coordinate
interpretation.squared_bias: empirical point and mean_noise_floor only; not a confidence interval for true squared bias
interpretation.intervals: approximate pointwise 95% paired percentile intervals; no simultaneous coverage or baseline-fit uncertainty
interpretation.paired_difference: method MSE minus reward-to-go MSE; below zero means lower error in this setting
interpretation.baseline: one sigma=2 training fit reused at every probe noise; extra fit budget recorded separately
interpretation.seeds: disjoint across probe settings/batches and training; shared between estimators within a batch
